data.name: Progress
data.doc: ## 何时使用 {#when-to-use} 在操作需要较长时间才能完成时，为用户显示该操作的当前进度和状态。 - 当一个操作会打断当前界面，或者需要在后台运行，且耗时可能超过 2 秒时； - 当需要显示一个操作完成的百分比时。 ## 代码演示 {#examples} 进度条 进度圈 小型进度条 响应式进度圈 小型进度圈 动态展示 自定义文字格式 仪表盘 分段进度条 边缘形状 自定义进度条渐变色 步骤进度条 步骤进度圈 尺寸 改变进度数值位置 自定义语义结构的样式和类 ## API 通用属性参考：[通用属性](/docs/react/common-props) 各类型共用的属性。 | 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 | [全局配置](/components/config-provider-cn#component-config) | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | classNames | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的 class，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), string> | - | 6.0.0 | 6.0.0 | | format | 内容的模板函数 | function(percent, successPercent) | (percent) => percent + `%` | - | × | | percent | 百分比 | number | 0 | - | × | | railColor | 未完成的分段的颜色 | string | - | - | × | | showInfo | 是否显示进度数值或状态图标 | boolean | true | - | × | | status | 状态，可选：`success` `exception` `normal` `active`(仅限 line) | string | - | - | × | | strokeColor | 进度条的色彩 | string | - | - | × | | strokeLinecap | 进度条的样式 | `round` \| `butt` \| `square`，区别详见 [stroke-linecap](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/stroke-linecap) | `round` | - | × | | styles | 用于自定义组件内部各语义化结构的行内 style，支持对象或函数 | Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> \| (info: { props })=> Record<[SemanticDOM](#semantic-dom), CSSProperties> | - | 6.0.0 | 6.0.0 | | success | 成功进度条相关配置 | { percent: number, strokeColor: string } | - | - | × | | ~~trailColor~~ | 未完成的分段的颜色。已废弃，请使用 `railColor` | string | - | - | × | | type | 类型，可选 `line` `circle` `dashboard` | string | `line` | - | × | | size | 进度条的尺寸 | number \| \[number \| string, number] \| { width: number, height: number } \| "small" \| "medium" | "medium" | 5.3.0, Object: 5.18.0 | × | ### `type="line"` | 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | steps | 进度条总共步数 | number | - | - | | rounding | 用于四舍五入数值的函数 | (step: number) => number | Math.round | 5.24.0 | | strokeColor | 进度条的色彩，传入 object 时为渐变。当有 `steps` 时支持传入一个数组。 | string \| string[] \| { from: string; to: string; direction: string } | - | 4.21.0: `string[]` | | percentPosition | 进度数值位置，传入对象，`align` 表示数值的水平位置，`type` 表示数值在进度条内部还是外部 | { align: string; type: string } | { align: \"end\", type: \"outer\" } | 5.18.0 | ### `type="circle"` | 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | steps | 进度条总共步数，传入 object 时，count 指步数，gap 指间隔大小。传 number 类型时，gap 默认为 2。 | number \| { count: number, gap: number } | - | 5.16.0 | | strokeColor | 圆形进度条线的色彩，传入 object 时为渐变 | string \| { number%: string } | - | - | | strokeWidth | 圆形进度条线的宽度，单位是进度条画布宽度的百分比 | number | 6 | - | ### `type="dashboard"` | 属性 | 说明 | 类型 | 默认值 | 版本 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | steps | 进度条总共步数，传入 object 时，count 指步数，gap 指间隔大小。传 number 类型时，gap 默认为 2。 | number \| { count: number, gap: number } | - | 5.16.0 | | gapDegree | 仪表盘进度条缺口角度，可取值 0 ~ 295 | number | 75 | - | | gapPlacement | 仪表盘进度条缺口位置 | `top` \| `bottom` \| `start` \| `end` | `bottom` | - | | ~~gapPosition~~ | 仪表盘进度条缺口位置，请使用 `gapPlacement` 替换 | `top` \| `bottom` \| `left` \| `right` | `bottom` | - | | strokeWidth | 仪表盘进度条线的宽度，单位是进度条画布宽度的百分比 | number | 6 | - | ## Semantic DOM ## 主题变量（Design Token）{#design-token}

demos.name: circle-micro
demos.title: Responsive circular progress bar
demos.description: Responsive circular progress bar. When `width` is smaller than 20, progress information will be displayed in Tooltip.

demos.name: circle-steps
demos.title: Circular progress bar with steps
demos.description: A circular progress bar that support steps and color segments, default gap is 2px.

demos.name: dashboard
demos.title: Dashboard
demos.description: By setting `type=dashboard`, you can get a dashboard style of progress easily.

demos.name: dynamic
demos.title: Dynamic
demos.description: A dynamic progress bar is better.

demos.name: format
demos.title: Custom text format
demos.description: You can set a custom text by setting the `format` prop.

demos.name: gradient-line
demos.title: Custom line gradient
demos.description: Gradient encapsulation, `circle` and `dashboard` will ignore `strokeLinecap` when setting gradient.

demos.name: info-position
demos.title: Change progress value position
demos.description: Change the position of the progress value, you can use `percentPosition` to adjust it so that the progress bar value is inside, outside or at the bottom of the progress bar.

demos.name: linecap
demos.title: Stroke Linecap
demos.description: By setting `strokeLinecap="butt"`, you can change the linecaps from `round` to `butt`, see [stroke-linecap](https://developer.mozilla.org/docs/Web/SVG/Attribute/stroke-linecap) for more information.

demos.name: segment
demos.title: Progress bar with success segment
demos.description: Show several parts of progress with different status.

demos.name: style-class
demos.title: Custom semantic dom styling
demos.description: You can customize the [semantic dom](#semantic-dom) style of Progress by passing objects or functions through `classNames` and `styles`.
